mkm.text: Etrata, a master assassin, is found out and captured after Zegana's murder, yet she cannot remember killing her despite recalling dozens of other murders.
Alquist Proft swears to clear her name, reasoning that if she was mind-controlled she is no more culpable than a knife, and he helps her slip out of Azorius custody to assist the investigation.

She saves Proft from Massacre Girl and helps him find the real killer, and when Oba's plot is unmasked she takes a root spear meant for Yarus, then plays dead until she can activate a barrier ward so that Oba can be pinned.
With House Dimir all but gone, she proposes becoming Proft's assistant, and he takes her under his wing as his aide.
